description: Self-checking suite for task 039.15: every Lua block printed in the conventions page, the getting-started walkthrough and the eight guides is executed here as written, so a snippet that no longer runs is a red line rather than a reader's first failure; plus the uniformity the sweep documents — every section is called and is one object, and a retired flat spelling throws naming what replaced it.
